d.ko: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.
d.en: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.
d.zh: 指挥一艘古老的星舰，一路杀入濒临覆灭的帝国腹地。击退癫狂的邪教徒、怯懦的太空海盗和仇视异族的帝国士兵。搜寻蕴藏强大力量的遗物，将你的星舰打造成令人胆寒的战争机器。
